body:
The parent #4365 is merged (`75e9b0ad7`). This branch now has `origin/main` merged in.

- Merge commit: `815ada17b` (`Merge main into issue/4335-tool-list-search`). It merges `159ee3748` of `main`.
- Conflicts: none. `git merge` resolved all files automatically. `git show --remerge-diff` is empty. Class: SAME.
- `git diff origin/main` lists only the files of the 2 commits of this PR.
- PR body: the first line now says that the parent is merged.

Gate on head `815ada17b501e627b5a5cd1fcc52ec8a2b7a05b1` (builder lane, Linux):
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 18 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `ready-check`: PASS.

Note: this PR and #4377 both add a line to the `mod` list in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`. This PR and #4385 both change `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_library_mockup.rs`. The PR that merges second takes `git merge origin/main` at that time.

Ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 815ada17b501e627b5a5cd1fcc52ec8a2b7a05b1 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat` PR: it merges at the next cut).

Review of head `815ada17b`, trial-merged locally with upstream/main `b2afd64ed`. The merge has no conflicts. This is the first review of this PR.

## What looks good

- The issue #4335 "Done means" items are complete:
  - Search tests for one term, two terms, a diameter, no match and Esc, in each of the three sources (`tool_library_search.rs`).
  - `layout_window_tool_library` asserts the one header row, the column heads and the "N of M tools" count.
  - The body has before and after screenshots. I found the four "after" images and the #4365 "before" image on the `pr-screenshots` branch of the fork.
- The matcher (`search.rs`) is small and pure, and it has its own unit tests. A diameter that is not finite or not above zero matches nothing. A number term with a bad form becomes a text term. There is no `unwrap`, `expect` or index math on a user path.
- Frame cost: the rows are keyed on `(doc_version, source)` and the hits on `(rev, text, unit)`. `doc_version` only goes up, so a stale key cannot come back. A counter test pins "a still frame builds nothing".
- The search is view state and it queues no command (the `quiet` assert). The Add of a Catalog row is still the `AddTool` command. The import options (#899, #889) stay, in the Import… menu, with their texts.
- The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` goes up (1961 to 1970). No test is deleted or ignored. No snapshot PNG changes.
- Each new module has a provenance line. Each new file is below 400 lines. There is no new crate dependency, and the decision file is present.

## Results (locally, on the trial merge)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 18 steps, 0 failed (ui build; ui lib 1779 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored; the 16 ui integration suites). The 9 new pinning tests pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Extra suites run: none were needed. The diff changes no `testdata/`, no fixture and no import code.
- Heavy lanes: not reached. The diff changes only `crates/ui` and a decision file. No posted G-code, collision check, simulation or geometry changes, so this is not a safety-tier review.
- Goldens moved: none. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file changes.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `docs/decisions/4335-tool-list-search.md` ("Dropped") names `ToolRow::new`. That function does not exist. The rows are made by `row()` in `tool_library_dialog/list_rows.rs`.
2. `crates/ui/src/state_tool_library.rs:20` and `:37`: the doc comments still name the old button labels "Export library…" and "Import library…".
3. `crates/ui/src/state.rs` is already far above 400 lines (5198). This PR adds 5 lines. This is not blocking.
4. No UI test uses an inch document. The matcher tests cover inch numbers, and the body says so.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

PR #4385 merged to main. Now this PR has a conflict with main in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_library_mockup.rs`. Please merge `main` into this branch. Do not rebase. Do not force-push. The review on head `815ada17b` stays valid for a clean merge of main. A conflict that you resolve by hand gets a short delta review. Then this PR can merge.

This PR is a draft again. U10 (#4377) and U11 (#4385) merged to `main`, and this branch now conflicts with `main`. A merge of `main` with hand edits follows. The review of 815ada1 then needs a delta review of the resolution.

Merged `main` (U10 #4377 and U11 #4385). Ready for a re-check.

Merge commit: 84618e3 (reviewed head: 815ada1). Class: DELTA. Two hunks are resolved by hand:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`, the test `mod` list. This branch adds `mod tool_library_search;`. `main` adds `mod tool_library_tool_tab;` and its `#4336` comment line. The resolution keeps the two lines.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_library_mockup.rs`, the `use` line of `camcraft_app::units`. The base had `use camcraft_app::units::{self, Unit};`. `main` removed its use of `Unit` (the Recipes test now finds the "Stepover" head) and kept `units`. This branch removed its use of `units::len` (the gauge cell now uses `list::compact`) and kept `Unit`. After the merge, the file uses neither name, so the resolution removes the two import lines. No other line of the file changes by hand.

All other files merge with no conflict. `git diff origin/main --name-only` lists the same files as the diff of 815ada1 against its merge base.

`#[test]` count of `crates/ui`: 1991 on `main`, 2000 on this branch. This branch adds 9 tests, as before.

Gate on 84618e3 (lane mac-1, log `gate-4381-84618e3.log`):
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 18 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (ui build, ui lib, and 16 ui integration suites).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Screenshots after the merge (the list keeps its header row, search box, count and columns):
- ![after merge: Document](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/4381/after-merge-document.png)
- ![after merge: Catalog, "6 ball"](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/4381/after-merge-catalog-search.png)

Delta refresh merged into main (84618e3). Relying on: the counted review of head 815ada1 by mkinney (collaborator, counted). The delta is a hand merge of main (U10 #4377, U11 #4385): tests.rs keeps both mod lines (tool_library_search + tool_library_tool_tab); tool_library_mockup.rs drops both import lines (neither name used after the merge). No logic merged; no rebuild needed. Ready for merge.
